about: I moved into IT engineering mid-career and have worked on web systems end to end — design, development, and testing — as well as cloud systems and IoT systems.
My core stack is Azure and React / TypeScript. Recently I have also been working on applied AI, including Azure AI Search, and on small tools that make day-to-day work easier.
